metadata.question: Was a phytoplankton bloom visible between 56° to 68° South latitude on January 13, 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location): - Collection: MODIS-Aqua L2 Chlorophyll-a (NASA/OCEANDATA/MODISA/L2) or MODIS-Aqua 8-day composite (NASA/OCEANDATA/MODISA/L3/CHL). - Date: January 13, 2016 (or the closest 8-day composite covering that date). - Location: 56°S to 68°S, global longitude. Use a polygon covering this lat band. 2. Masking strategy: Keep only >0 and ≤100 mg/m³ Chl-a pixels. (The L3 composite is already masked for land/cloud.) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - C1: collection size == 0. - C2: valid pixel count == 0. - If valid mean Chl-a is None, NaN, or outside plausible range → C3. - A bloom is usually considered present if mean Chl-a > 1 mg/m³ in Southern Ocean; otherwise B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time latBand = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -68, 180, -56]) date = '2016-01-13' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODISA/L3/CHL') \ .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(8, 'day')) \ .filterBounds(latBand) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No L3 image.") print("C1") exit() img = col.first().select('chlor_a') # 3. Processing & valid-pixel count mask = img.gt(0).And(img.lte(100)) img = img.updateMask(mask) count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=latBand, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") exit() # 4. Calculation meanChl = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=latBand, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Answer print(f"Chl-a: {meanChl:.2f} mg/m³, Pixels: {int(count)}") if meanChl is None or meanChl != meanChl or meanChl < 0 or meanChl > 100: print("C3") elif meanChl > 1.0: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
latBand = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -68, 180, -56])
date = '2016-01-13'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODISA/L3/CHL') \
        .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(8, 'day')) \
        .filterBounds(latBand)
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No L3 image.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

img = col.first().select('chlor_a')

# 3. Processing & valid-pixel count
mask = img.gt(0).And(img.lte(100))
img = img.updateMask(mask)
count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                         geometry=latBand, scale=4000,
                         maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo()
if count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculation
meanChl = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                           geometry=latBand, scale=4000,
                           maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Answer
print(f"Chl-a: {meanChl:.2f} mg/m³, Pixels: {int(count)}")
if meanChl is None or meanChl != meanChl or meanChl < 0 or meanChl > 100:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif meanChl > 1.0:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
